parent.cost: Measured complete parent prefix, including imports/loading/checking/cleanup, charged once per logical arm; one actual shared execution per case/repetition

restarts.seed: SHA256(UTF8(case+":"+str(repetition)+":cost-matched-v1")), first 8 digest bytes big endian, Python random.Random
restarts.perturbations: Interior insertion moves from frozen parent, fixed before continuation; unrestricted full-order insertion destinations during search

window.scope: One supplied frozen parent revalidated without extra native parent search; unused parent allocation flows to child; owned startup/JIT/check/cleanup charged

primary.statistic: Per-case median of two within-repetition physical-error differences(window minus full)
primary.window_advantage: Both case medians < -1e-12, no resolved loss in either primary repetition, and all cost/verification gates pass

physical.repetitions_scope: Deterministic timing repetitions, not independent molecular samples; no confidence intervals

accounting.continuation_allowance: Total cap minus conservative measured frozen-parent prefix; subtract complete continuation setup and .25CPU cleanup reserve before API entry
accounting.actual_vs_attributed: Per four continuations actual parentCPU+sumcontinuation; comparison charges4*parentCPU+sumcontinuation; never multiply constructor costs by physical rows

preflight.gate: Complete source/order/cost/objective/primary/independent paths, no algorithm cap prematurely stopping intendedCPU-limited continuation, memory upper<=400MiB; fail/retain without changing holdout choices

failures: Retain all attempts/costs/partial outputs; fully checked incumbents only; controller parent fallback explicit; no geometry substitution after input freeze; failed or unverified primary comparisons cannot support advantage
scope: Cost/quality allocation on two fixed new geometries and two CPU allowances, not global ordering/approximation/hardware claim
attempt_policy: One invocation per frozen main parent or continuation identity. No fresh-budget retry. A failed continuation retains all costs and an explicit ineligible parent fallback; preflight repairs precede holdout outcomes and retain all attempts.
